messages:
ashley (billing): Postmortem follow-up: we need owners/timelines for token delta remediation and invoice corrections. Please state commitments here.

devin (ingest): Root cause = late-event drop in batch-merge. Patch ready; will run a corrected ingestion and produce per-account delta CSV. ETA 48h. Owner: devin.

jana (invoicing): We need CSV columns: customer_id, billed_tokens, corrected_tokens, delta_tokens, date_range, note. With that I can create tickets and reissue invoices.

mike (reconciliation): I'll do customer outreach and analytics tagging (adjustment_reason=INGESTION_LAG_2026-03). Need Jana to attach ticket IDs to the CSV rows.

sara (finance): I'll prepare the customer comms template and handle priority accounts. Can take 12 tickets this sprint.

ryan (eng-infra): Quick mitigation pushed to prod to stop retries from overwriting merges. I'll post PR link. Follow-up hardening by week end. Owner: ryan.

ops-bot: Manual run scheduled if CI blocks deployment.

ashley (billing): Action list captured here: A1 produce per-account delta CSV (devin, due 2026-03-23); A2 harden retry guard (ryan, due 2026-03-20); A3 open 34 correction tickets + comms (jana+sara+mike, due 2026-03-27); A4 tag invoices with adjustment_reason (mike, due 2026-03-27); A5 weekly audit query x8 (ashley, start 2026-03-30).

devin (ingest): CSV will be uploaded to secure S3 and shared. I will include a checksum and sample raw_event_ids for auditors.

jana (invoicing): Once CSV available I'll split tickets and flag enterprise/dispute priorities.

mike (reconciliation): Will update analytics and confirm counts. Need final numbers before we notify execs: total corrected tokens, invoices adjusted, total credit amount.

ashley (billing): Please update this thread as each action completes so I can close the loop in the billing postmortem on 2026-03-30. Thanks.
